messages:
Anya R: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem — want to lock owners/timelines for the recurring patterns we saw (bursty leaderboards, long KV cache churn). I sketched a short action list below, plz ack and add owners if missing.

Samir: Ack. Can you paste the list?

Anya R: Sure — TL;DR items: 1) Quota floor & tiered reservations (prevent noisy tenants starving headroom), owner: @Samir, target: 2w (RW-2019). 2) Scheduler backoff tuning + soft preemption window, owner: @Leo C, target: 1wk (RW-2021). 3) Autoscale smoothing rules (avoid 3x oscillations during spikes), owner: @Morgan_T, target: next sprint (RW-2022). 4) Postmortem eval harness (replay traces to validate changes), owner: infra-team, target: 3w (RW-2023). 5) Runbook update + pager thresholds, owner: @Anya R, target: 1w.

Leo C: I can take #2. Initial thought: increase probe interval and add a 15s soft preemption to let KV writes finish. Example flag we can try: 
```
--scheduler-probe-interval=10s 
--preempt-soft-window=15s
```
I’ll open RW-2021 and run a canary on staging.

Morgan_T: Taking #3. I'll prototype a PID-like smoothing layer that applies a short cooldown after scale-up. Will put a draft policy in RW-2022 with simulation results.

Samir: For #1 quota floor: we should define two knobs — guaranteed headroom and burstable cap. I'll propose values based on last 4 incidents' peak percentiles. Plan: metric scrape + PR to reservation controller by EOD Friday.

Anya R: Nice. For #4, infra-team means @Samir + @Leo C + @infra-sig. If you want help building the replay harness I can allocate time from SRE. RW-2023 should include a representative trace from the Mar 11 outage.

Samir: Agree. Re: traces — where are they? I couldn't find a clean exported file.

incident-bot: Export job RW-trace-export-1759 completed: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/traces/trace-2026-03-11.tar.gz

Samir: Got it, thanks bot.

Leo C: Quick note on metrics: add a derived series "gpu_headroom_pct" and an alert if it drops below 12% for >2m (we saw long tail at ~8%). I’ll add to RW-2021.

Morgan_T: Also suggest a short-term mitigation: enable per-tenant soft-capping on top of reservation for 72h window during rollout. Can be toggled via feature flag. I’ll attach a YAML toggle in RW-2022.

Anya R: Action owners summary (will paste to the postmortem doc):
- Samir: RW-2019 quota floor + reservation PR (due in 14d)
- Leo C: RW-2021 scheduler backoff & alerting (due in 7d)
- Morgan_T: RW-2022 autoscale smoothing + feature flag (due next sprint)
- Infra team: RW-2023 replay harness + validation (due in 21d)
- Anya R: Runbook + pager thresholds (due in 7d)

Samir: I’ll create the PR draft today and assign reviewers (cc @Anya R).

Leo C: Starting RW-2021 canary today, will report results in #eng-runtime.

Morgan_T: Putting a short RFC in RW-2022 by tomorrow.

Anya R: Great — can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when their ticket is created so I can track? I’ll follow up in 48h with a checkpoint.

Samir: :white_check_mark:

Leo C: :white_check_mark:

Morgan_T: :white_check_mark:

Anya R: Thanks — adding these to the postmortem follow-up checklist now: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/gpu-capacity-postmortem/followups
